answer: Identity aging ties voting weight to sustained proof-of-work: a fresh agent starts as an umber, low-trust seed and must accumulate verified action history while continuously burning compute on rotating challenges. Only after months of consistent output does it reach crystal-tier trust, and a raven-style audit bot samples old work for fraud. Launching N sybils costs N times months of compute plus forfeited history, so the attacker pays linear real cost for sublinear influence.
